tasks.label: Package for Workshop
args: $source = '${workspaceFolder}'; $workshopRoot = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Zomboid\Workshop\EngineFixesAndTweaks'; $destination = Join-Path $workshopRoot 'Contents\mods\EngineFixesAndTweaks'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $destination) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $destination -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destination -Force | Out-Null; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $source -Force | Where-Object { $_.Name -notin @('.git', 'java', '.vscode', '.gitignore', 'workshop.txt', 'preview.png') } | Copy-Item -Destination $destination -Recurse -Force; $workshopMetadata = Join-Path $source 'workshop.txt'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $workshopMetadata) { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $workshopMetadata -Destination (Join-Path $workshopRoot 'workshop.txt') -Force }; $preview = Join-Path $source 'preview.png'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $preview) { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $preview -Destination (Join-Path $workshopRoot 'preview.png') -Force }
